tokens.name: ease.spring
tokens.description: Confirmation: pill slide, toggle, count settle

tokens.name: ease.elastic
tokens.description: Elastic settle: overshoots about 10% and springs back. Selection indicators (tabs, segmented controls). One gentle overshoot, never a wobble. Pair with --duration-slower.

tokens.name: ease.move
tokens.description: Movement and arrival (1.2): lifts, presses, hovers, menus, dialogs, toasts, floating sheets, rises, accordions. Elastic: a small overshoot, then settle. Not for colour or opacity, exits, data, loops or edge-attached panels.
